alex kim: quick flag 1: new quant fold qx4b triggered truncation on long mixed-lang prompts (zh+en). found in longctx holdout.

maria gonzalez: can you paste a short example?

alex kim: repro snippet: `{"user":"今天... and then long english continuation"}` -> `{"assistant":"...可以","meta":"\u0000"}` ends mid-field.

samir patel: initial look: packing alignment in quant path looks suspect at high seq lengths when token-type flips.

natalie chen: reproduced on g5-equivalent with quant weights; float baseline clean.

priya rao: curation ask: do NOT delete these anchors. quarantine them and add to a small golden subset for regression tests.

labeler-bot: created label batch LB-4812 (300 samples) with guide: mark TRUNCATED / MALFORMED / OK. Assigning to intl-annotators. Link: https://labels.internal/review/LB-4812

infra-bot: snapshot created: snapshot://holdout-longmix-3843211234 sha:bb72a1 stored at /eval/snapshots/holdout-longmix-3843211234.

samir patel: rolling back qx4b-canary and opening ML-1405 for packing fix + unit tests. If failure rate >3% vs float on the golden subset, block merge.

maria gonzalez: action items: (1) quarantine & snapshot (done), (2) label LB-4812, (3) add failing golds to regression harness, (4) triage ML-1405. schedule curation + infra sync tomorrow.

alex kim: thanks all. I'll attach reproducer scripts and tokenizer flags to ML-1405.

labeler-bot: LB-4812 progress: 300 queued -> 48 completed -> 6 TRUNCATED, 1 AMBIG. tags added: `regression/quant`, `quarantine/longmix`.
